id: title:eli-r-ph:keep the warpstream client label when claiming a pod

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the pod claiming behavior in the WarpStream integration to retain the `posthog.com/warpstream-client` label alongside the app name, while removing other labels. This could prevent pods from losing the label required to produce to Kafka after being claimed.
review.reason: Adds a frozenset of retained labels including the WarpStream client label, and updates pod claiming implementation and tests to preserve this label while stripping others. This establishes a bounded correctness improvement for the WarpStream agent connectivity, though the score is not multiplied by the number of PRs or lines.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that retaining this label is necessary for Kafka connectivity; while the code implements this safeguard, the actual production impact and whether this prevents a specific class of failure are not independently verified. No tests are shown to fail before this change, and no release notes or WPR are available to establish realized benefit. The PRs
